login.title: What’s your phone number?
login.sub: We’ll send a 6-digit code by SMS. No password needed.
login.failed: We couldn’t sign you in. Check your internet and try again.
login.mock: Test mode: no SMS is sent. Use code 123456.
login.sendFailed: We couldn’t send the code. Check your internet and try again.

shell.comingBody: This screen arrives with module {module}. The design is ready on the Customer screens canvas.
shell.fieldBody: The {role} screens are designed at the start of Phase 3.

welcome.title: Ghar ka khana, bina tension.
welcome.sub: Your family’s week of food, planned and delivered by your society.
welcome.later: You can change this later in Profile.

otp.title: Enter the code
otp.auto: Reading the SMS for you. On Android the code fills in by itself.
otp.invalid: That code isn’t right. Check the SMS and try again.
otp.expired: This code has expired. Send a new one.
otp.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
otp.region: We can’t send SMS to this number yet.
otp.failed: We couldn’t sign you in. Check your internet and try again.

outbox.waiting: {count, plural, one {# action waiting to sync} other {# actions waiting to sync}}

install.title: Install GharBasket
install.body: Open your week from the home screen, even on a weak connection.
install.iosSteps: Tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.

onboarding.error: We couldn’t load this. Check your internet.

society.title: Which society do you live in?

flat.capBody: She lives in {flat}. She receives your society’s delivery and brings your box to your door.

unlock.remaining: {n, plural, one {# more home} other {# more homes}} to unlock delivery. Invite a neighbour.

request.title: Request your society
request.sub: Put the pin on your building. We’ll tell you when GharBasket starts there.
request.caption: Drag the pin onto your building
request.name: Society name
request.note: The more neighbours who join from one society, the sooner delivery starts there.
request.sent: Request sent. We’ll let you know.

family.title: Who eats at home?
family.sub: Autopilot plans portions for each person.
family.total: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}. You can add names and details later in Profile.

food.title: What does your family eat?
food.jainDesc: No onion, garlic or root vegetables
food.noOnion: No onion and garlic on some days
food.fastNote: On fasting days Autopilot plans upvas food like sabudana khichdi.

health.title: Any health needs?
health.why: so Autopilot can plan, for example, low-sugar meals for someone with diabetes.
health.use1: Only the tags you pick below
health.use2: Never shared with cooks, riders or captains
health.use3: Turn off any time in Profile › Privacy

cooking.title: How much time do you have to cook?
cooking.sub: Busy days get quicker recipes or a cut-veg kit.
cooking.noCookNote: We’ll suggest a tiffin from a home cook in your society on these days.

budget.title: Fix your monthly sabzi bill?
budget.sub: With Budget Lock, Autopilot swaps in a similar vegetable when prices spike, so you stay within budget.
budget.exBody: Tomato is up 40% this week. Autopilot uses lauki in two meals instead and shows why on your box.

consent.title: Your data, your choice
consent.sub: Here’s what we use and why. Change any of it later in Profile › Privacy.
consent.accBody: Phone, address and household size, so we can plan and deliver your box.
consent.healthDesc: Health tags you picked, used only for meal planning.
consent.whatsappDesc: Box ready, payment notices and delivery updates.
consent.insightsDesc: Your edits, without your name, help plan better boxes for neighbours.
consent.post: . You can download or delete your data any time.
consent.failed: We couldn’t save your household. Check your internet and try again.

preview.title: Here’s your first week
preview.sub: Planned for families like yours. It learns from every edit.
preview.box: Sabzi box · {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}

payment.title: How do you want to pay?
payment.sub: Each week’s box is paid at the cut-off, 9 PM the day before delivery.
payment.walletDesc: Top up with UPI once. Each box is paid from the wallet, and refunds come back here instantly.
payment.autopayDesc: Charged per box. We send a notice 24 hours before every charge. Cancel any time.
payment.rules: Usable only on GharBasket. Balance up to ₹10,000. Unused money goes back to your bank on request.
payment.testBody: Test mode: no real money moves. Razorpay Checkout replaces this once spike S-1 is done.

errors.generic: Payment didn’t go through. No money was taken. Try again.
errors.billing_wallet_limit: Your wallet can hold up to ₹10,000
errors.payment_checkout_unavailable: Couldn’t open the payment page. Check your internet.

done.title: You’re all set. First box on {day}.
done.sub: We’ll message you on Saturday evening when your box is ready to check.
done.invite: Delivery is free in your society. Invite a neighbour: you get a reward when their first box is delivered.
done.shareText: Join me on GharBasket in {society}: the week’s food, planned and delivered.

lead.skipped: This week is skipped. No box and no charge.
lead.locked: Edits are closed. Your box is being packed.

week.skipBody: No box this week and no charge ({amount}). You can plan next week as usual.
week.changed: Your box changed. Check it again.

society.started: Deliveries are on. Your captain is {captain}.
society.captainBody: A captain receives the society’s delivery and earns for every box. Live in {society}?
society.planBody: Your Autopilot week starts as soon as the society unlocks.
